verdict_raw:
**QA Findings**

**(1) Overlapping / clipping**
- **Possible clipped control, top toolbar right edge** (~x 1245–1255, y 15–30): two tiny vertical marks sit flush against the viewport edge after "Share." Looks like a truncated icon or collapsed handle. Low severity but reads as an artifact.
- The "Patios & Paths" header (~y 749) sits at the very bottom of the left panel with zero items visible. This is consistent with a scrollable palette, so acceptable — but it's the tightest edge on screen.
- No true overlaps found: tooltip / "Daytime" pill / compass / floating tool cluster / zoom stack / scale bar all have clean separation.

**(2) 5-second comprehension — PASS**
- Layout is legible: palette on the left, canvas center, properties inspector right, status bar bottom. Selected-object state is reinforced in three consistent places (fence highlighted on canvas, floating label, right panel "Privacy Fence / Object #1") and values all agree (24 ft length, position −15.0, 0.0). A new user would get it in ~5 seconds.

**(3) Confusing / suspicious items**
- **"Innovate" button (~x 630–717, y 729–759)** — almost certainly a typo for **"Irrigate"** given its neighbors (Tape Measure, Excavate, Analyze, Sun) are all physical yard operations. A lightbulb icon + "Innovate" in a backyard tool is meaningless to a new user. Highest-priority fix.
- **Blue perimeter around the grass lot** (e.g., left ~x 280–420, right ~x 845–958): the grid continues onto the blue area, so it reads as "my yard is surrounded by water" rather than "edge of terrain plane." Cosmetic but potentially confusing.
- **Link icon** between the rotate-left/rotate-right buttons (~x 1042, y 307): purpose is unlabeled and ambiguous.
- Minor: "Brush: 8 ft" and "FPS: —" in the status bar are dead/irrelevant while the Select tool is active.

**Verdict:** Not CLEAN — ship-blocking only if "Innovate" is unchecked (a real user-facing typo); everything else is minor polish.
